pin.headline: Never lose your keys or bag again
pin.sub: 50% louder chime · Longer range · Apple Watch finding · IP67

scenes.line: Lost your keys again? This little tag now finds them from up to fifty percent farther away.
Meet the new Apple AirTag, second generation. A new Ultra Wideband chip extends Precision Finding, and the chime is fifty percent louder.
Built for iPhone users. Tag your keys, backpack, suitcase and car, and now you can find them right from your Apple Watch too.

scenes.title: PRO TIP
scenes.note: Find My warns you when a battery runs low. Not for Android.
scenes.line: Pro tip: it runs on a swappable coin battery, about a year each. Keep a spare in a drawer, and you'll need an iPhone fifteen or newer for the longest range.
It's pick number fifteen. Find the link on our channel, under Video Picks.
